meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: Claude 在 claude-mem 的生成循环里只回 XML:空闲或没有工具结果时回 skip_summary,完成可搜索单元时回一条 observation(真实标题、4–10 条带路径的事实),结果写进 outbox/{id}.txt 或作为 chat-completions 正文返回。
howto.when: 当它作为 claude-mem 的观察者模型处理收件箱任务,或需要把 XML 作为 chat-completions 正文返回时接管;空闲、初始化、没有工具结果时走 skip_summary。

say.text: 这条任务没有工具结果,回 skip_summary reason=noise
把这个可搜索单元写成一条 observation,带 4–10 条事实和路径
结果写到 outbox/{id}.txt,不要直接 POST 保存接口

howto.what_en: Inside claude-mem's generator loop, Claude replies with XML only: skip_summary when idle or with no tool results, or one observation (real title, 4–10 facts with paths). Output goes to outbox/{id}.txt or the chat-completions body.
howto.when_en: Triggers when it acts as the claude-mem observer handling inbox jobs, or returns the XML as the chat-completions body; idle, init, or no tool results go to skip_summary.

say_en.text: No tool results for this job — reply skip_summary reason=noise
Write this searchable unit as one observation with 4–10 facts and paths
Write the result to outbox/{id}.txt, don't POST the save endpoint
